name: [otel demo] ad pod at its CPU limit (${ENV_NAME})
message:
The ad container is using over 90% of its CPU limit (pod {{pod_name.name}}), from the Collector's Kubernetes metrics.

Follow it: [ad latency alert](https://app.datad0g.com/monitors/35243022) · [ad service](https://app.datad0g.com/apm/services/ad?env=${ENV_NAME}) · [recent changes on ad](https://app.datad0g.com/event/explorer?query=service%3Aad%20env%3A${ENV_NAME})

Grouped by pod so it sits on the pod in Kubernetes Explorer, where the hourly demo opens. No notification targets on purpose.
